verdict.rationale: Jira's own feature page describes a built-in AI, Rovo AI, that breaks big ideas into tasks, assigns them, builds custom automations, and surfaces trends, so users can hand some work to it inside the product. The evidence is only short marketing lines with no detail on how delegation works. missing for 10: in-depth docs on delegating arbitrary tasks to Rovo as an agent, its scope and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Breakdown big ideas into actionable tasks and automatically assign them to the right person with Rovo AI.
Use Rovo AI to create custom automations to keep your status up to date - from automated reminders to rules that move work forward.
Use Rovo AI to identify trends to surface new opportunities and remove bottle necks.
